前置要求 - 游戏版本：RimWorld 1.6 - 必需依赖：Harmony（自动加载） - 语言：简体中文 / English
这是个啥 给殖民地请个「史官」，自动记录人物、物品、战役、地点，主界面底部「档案馆」按钮随时翻看。
都能干啥 - 总览：分类统计 + 最新事件流 + KPI 仪表盘，随时掌握殖民地动态。 - 分类浏览：人物 / 物品 / 战役 / 地点，一个都别想跑。 - 详情：时间轴 + 关联档案网络，谁摸鱼、谁背锅一目了然。 - 人物小传：生涯工时分档（核动力驴 / 超级牛马 / 常规牛马 / 劣质牛马 / 社会懒汉）、战斗履历、社会关系、足迹、健康残值。 - 检视面板：在 pawn 检视页签直接打开专属档案（v4.6）。 - 阵营图鉴（v4.3）、传承 / 所有权变更链（v4.7）、榨取总账、产出核销。
老板视角 本模组就是给你这尊「黑心老板」准备的：谁加班最多、谁划水最狠、谁惹了祸还甩锅，全记在小本本上。年终奖发不发另说，至少账算得门儿清。
接入说明 对外提供统一接入契约（PersonalChronicleApi 门面 + Provider 注册表），第三方模组可无侵入扩展采集与能力，Provider 异常失败隔离。API 契约版本 1.0，与发布版本号保持一致。
与 Character Editor 共存 本模组在 Languages/ChineseSimplified 下提供翻译文件的同时，已附带 LanguageInfo.xml 元数据，确保简体中文语言身份被正确识别。若同时启用 Character Editor，其编辑器窗口内的中文依赖游戏当前语言的 FriendlyNameEnglish；本模组不修改任何翻译系统，仅补全自身语言元数据以避免语言聚合时的回退命名冲突。如仍发现 CE 编辑器显示英文，请确认简体中文语言包（含 LanguageInfo.xml）已启用且加载顺序正确。
Personal Chronicle · 殖民地档案馆 · v1.1.4 · 国人开发

Requirements - Game version: RimWorld 1.6 - Required dependency: Harmony (auto-loaded) - Languages: Simplified Chinese / English
What is this Hire a "court historian" for your colony. It auto-records pawns, things, battles and locations, and the "Archive" button on the main tab bar lets you flip through it anytime.
What it does - Overview: category stats + latest event feed + KPI dashboard. - Categories: pawns / things / battles / locations — nobody slips through. - Detail: timeline + relation network. Who slacked off, who took the blame, all in the book. - Pawn profile: career work-hours tier (Reactor Mule / Super Workhorse / Regular Workhorse / Poor Workhorse / Social Slacker), battle record, social relations, footprint, health valuation. - Inspect tab: open a pawn's archive directly from its inspect panel (v4.6). - Faction codex (v4.3), legacy / ownership chain (v4.7), exploitation ledger, output reconciliation.
Integration Ships a unified integration contract (PersonalChronicleApi facade + Provider registry) so third-party mods can extend capture and capabilities non-invasively, with per-provider failure isolation. API contract version 1.0, aligned with the mod version.
Coexistence with Character Editor This mod ships its translation files under Languages/ChineseSimplified together with a LanguageInfo.xml metadata file, so the Simplified Chinese language identity is recognized correctly. When Character Editor is also enabled, the Chinese text inside its editor window depends on the game's current language FriendlyNameEnglish; this mod does not alter any translation system — it only supplies its own language metadata to avoid fallback-naming conflicts during language aggregation. If CE's editor still shows English, make sure the Simplified Chinese language pack (with its own LanguageInfo.xml) is enabled and loaded in the correct order.
Personal Chronicle · Colony Archive · v1.1.4 · made by a Chinese dev
